# Self-learning — the pot-scoped learning system

**Self-learning** is the umbrella for everything a Pot does to improve itself
without being told to. It is not one loop but **three complementary modes**, each
with its own doc, plus three cross-cutting rails (scope, spend, grading) that
apply to all of them.

## The three modes

| Mode | What it does | Engine | Deep doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Reactive capture** | Captures friction/ideas the moment a turn sees them (`improvements:capture`), triages, and drives them to resolution. | idea queue + watchdogs | [observations](/internal/docs/system/observations) |
| **Exploitative refinement** | A/B-refines blueprints/components that already exist — champion/challenger cycles under a budget, one pot per round-robin tick. | the **Gym** (`packages/operator-core/lib/gym/`, `autoloop-cycle.ts`) | `gym-as-blueprint` insight |
| **Generative exploration** | Prompt-free divergent ideation over the corpus digest — lenses → critics → recombine → route into the existing rails. | the **Scout loop** (`packages/operator-core/lib/scout/`) | [scout-loop](/internal/docs/system/scout-loop) |

In the product lexicon the learning surface is the **Blender**: the desktop
left-rail Blender pane (`lst=blender`; `apps/operator-vite/src/components/left-sidebar/`)
hosts the **Arming** section (which lanes are on, with what budget) and the
scout/gym read-side; the `adv/LearningTab` is the read-side deep view. The
agent-facing scout tools carry the same name (`blender:success-metrics`,
`blender:grade-idea`, `blender:run-drill`, …).

## Rail 1 — the pot-scope invariant

> [owner 2026-07-25, verbatim] "THERE SHOULD BE NO WORKSPACE SCOPED LEARNINGS.
> FIX THAT. ALL LEARNINGS SHOULD BE SCOPED TO A POT."

Every learning row (scout ticks, gym runs, recipes, calibration predictions, …)
is attributed to the **pot** it belongs to, through the ONE shared seam
`resolveLearningPotScope` (`packages/operator-core/lib/learning/pot-scope.ts`) —
never a per-store re-derivation. Resolution order (deliberate):

1. an **explicit `potSlug`** from the caller — never second-guessed;
2. the pot that **owns the harness** (`potHomeSlugForHarness`) — the harness is
   the member sub-grain, the pot is the tenancy unit;
3. a **workspace-global label** (`@singleton`, `operator`, the workspace id)
   homes to the workspace **platform pot** (operator-level provenance and the
   platform pot are the same product);
4. the process home-pot env (`PAPERCUSP_POT_HOME_SLUG`);
5. **`null` — a real answer.** A context-less writer records `null` and is
   **excluded from every pot lens**; there is deliberately no "else the home
   pot" fallback, because a wrong-but-plausible attribution silently re-creates
   cross-tenant data (WI-5809).

## Rail 2 — spend governance + arming

Every always-on lane registers a `learning_governor_loops` row keyed
`<lane>:<pot>` (`gym:<slug>`, `blender:<slug>`, plus the frontier lanes —
red-queen, regret-mining, transfer, …) carrying its USD budget; the
**learning governor** (`packages/operator-core/lib/learning-governor/`) enforces
spend fail-closed.

Arming is **two-layer by construction** — a lane needs both its scheduler config
AND its governor row. The audited switches write both atomically:

- **`gym:arm`** — enable/disable + budget the gym autoloop for one pot: writes
  `gym_autoloop_config` (what the gym-cycle round-robin reads) and the
  `gym:<slug>` governor row together. Forgetting one layer historically left a
  pot that either never cycles or cycles ungoverned.
- **`governor:arm`** — the same for any non-gym lane by loopId.

The Blender pane's Arming section drives these same tools through the run-tool
bridge — the owner UI and the agent path are one switch.

## Rail 3 — grading + outcome closure

Routed scout ideas (`scout_routed_ideas`) are graded on **two layers**:

- **Automated closure** — `outcome` / `outcome_checked_at`, written by the
  outcome loop for **all** origins. This is the layer that proves the loop is
  closed; `human_grade IS NULL` does **not** mean grading is broken.
- **Human grading** — `blender:grade-idea` (optional layer; expected for
  su-ideate-filed ideas). A grade ≤3 with feedback wakes the originating
  session for revision (`revisionWake.fallback: true` when it is not live).

Release-bar measurement rides **rubrics + scorecards** (`rubrics:trend`,
`blender:success-metrics`, scorecards filed via `improvements:capture`) — see
[rubrics-scorecards](/internal/docs/system/rubrics-scorecards).

## Gates

A learning lane is live only when **three gates** align — its feature flag
(`papercusp-learning-governor`, `papercusp-per-hive-learning-loops`, the
`papercusp-scout-*` rails), its governor row (enabled + budget), and its
schedule/routine — see the
[dark-learning-loops-are-triple-gated](/internal/docs/agent-insights/dark-learning-loops-are-triple-gated)
insight before concluding a lane is broken.

Distribution of what a pot has learned (packs of curated learnings) is the
[knowledge-packs](/internal/docs/system/knowledge-packs) system.
